title: Nutty Saudi Arabian Noodle Dish
description: A sour and juicy noodle dish featuring agemono deep fried ingredients, served on a wooden board, inspired by Mediterranean and Saudi Arabian flavors. This dish is perfect for a monsoon day.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped pine nuts to the pan and fry until golden brown.
Remove the pine nuts from the pan and set aside.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pan and fry for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, paprika, and salt to the pan and fry for 1 minute.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the noodles and stir to combine.
Add the fried pine nuts to the noodles and stir to combine.
Serve the noodle dish on a wooden board and garnish with additional pine nuts if desired.
